about: Lohan v Take-Two Interactive Software (Delta, pillar 7, pop culture). NY Court of Appeals, 2018 NY Slip Op 02208, decided March 29 2018, opinion by Judge Fahey, five judges concurring, Judge Wilson took no part (Reuters: 6-0). Held: an avatar may constitute a 'portrait' under Civil Rights Law 50-51 (enacted 1903), but the Lacey Jonas character and the two loading-screen images are 'not recognizable as plaintiff' ('a generic artistic depiction of a "twenty something" woman'), so the amended complaint was properly dismissed. Suit filed July 2 2014 in Manhattan (AP). Gravano v Take-Two (2018 NY Slip Op 02207) decided the same day, same result (on screen only). No GTA 6 date line (remake 2026-11-18: posts after the Nov 19 launch); the voice says nothing date-dependent. Sources in BRIEF.md.
